title: Barriers reported as a failure, of 22 known ones
description: Test bench of barrierlab.eu, measured 12 and 13 November 2026: practice pages with 22 known barriers. Lighthouse and Alfa report 10, QualWeb 9, axe-core, IBM Equal Access and barrierlab-cli 8, Pa11y with HTML_CodeSniffer 7, html-validate 5. barrierlab-cli and html-validate read the page without a browser; the others run in one.
